Converts between Japanese grid square (mesh) codes, from 80 km down to 100 m, and latitude–longitude coordinates, and maps them with 'ggplot2' and 'leaflet'. On [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=jpmesh); documentation at [uribo.github.io/jpmesh](https://uribo.github.io/jpmesh/); source on [GitHub](https://github.com/uribo/jpmesh).
